statement: What GitHub CI repeats from files it cannot read (the Bun version, the seed matrix, the ast-grep version) is compared with its source from code, never from a comment, in every workflow file whatever its extension, and a form the comparison cannot read (a setup-bun step with no bun-version, a bun-version-file) is a problem, not a pass.
source: coordinator 10-01 (PR #90 review: the reviewer planted four drifts that stayed green)

layers.arrival: n/a: a repository gate rule, not protocol behaviour; no spec page models it
layers.quint: n/a: a repository gate rule, not protocol behaviour; no spec models it
layers.contract: n/a: a gate over the repository (pure/rules); it is not contract code
layers.rig: n/a: a gate over the repository, with no system state for the walk

killers.name: R-GATE-CI-DRIFT packageManager, bun-version, the seed matrix, the default seeds and the pins are read from their own syntax
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT the real workflows, package.json files and style/check.ts agree
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT the real files hold at least one copy of each thing compared (the comparison is not vacuous)
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT a job on another Bun than packageManager
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT a seed matrix that is not the default of test:seeds
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT an ast-grep on PATH that is not the one style/check.ts runs
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT an unpinned ast-grep in style/check.ts, a missing packageManager and a missing default are problems, not silence
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT a setup-bun step with no bun-version is a problem, and a bun-version in another step does not rescue it
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT bun-version-file is a problem: the file cannot be compared with packageManager
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT a setup-bun step is found with its with-block, whatever else sits around it
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT a workflow named .yaml is read, and so is every file in .github/workflows
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT an install that lost its pin is a problem even when a comment still names the pin
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT a comment is never a copy: a commented bun-version, seed matrix or pin counts for nothing
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT the same plants on the real build-and-test.yml go red (its own syntax, its own comments)
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT a comment that names ast-grep-cli without a pin is not an install, so it is no problem
R-GATE-CI-DRIFT the setup-bun action is found in any case, as GitHub reads action names without case
